title.narrative: HPMP Umbrella project for conversion from HCFC-141b to cyclopentane insulation foam blowing technology at three refrigeration appliances manufacturing enterprises: FERSA, Frigopanel and Metalfrio

description.narrative: HCFC PHASE-OUT MANAGEMENT PLAN (STAGE I, FIRST TRANCHE) The objective of this project is to assist Mexico in complying with the country#s obligation to freeze the consumption of HCFC by 2013 and reduce the base line HCFC consumption by 10% by 1 January 2015. Through the project three commercial refrigeration companies (FERSA, FRIGOPANEL AND METALFRIO) will phase out their total consumption of HCF-141b (the only ODS they use) replacing it with cyclopentane as blowing agent in their insulation foam manufacturing operation.
